name: China-Met2024
description: This release accompanies the manuscript "Systematic benchmarking of deep learning architectures for meteorological time series imputation". Contents: China-Met2024 benchmark dataset: hourly observations of temperature, pressure, and wind speed from 405 high-quality meteorological stations across China for the full year 2024. Quality-control and preprocessing pipeline. Implementations of four statistical baselines (mean, linear interpolation, cubic spline, and second-order polynomial fit) and three deep learning methods (BRITS, SAITS, and MAB-Net with architectural variants). Complete experimental framework for 291 controlled experiments across three missing patterns (random, continuous, and block), three missing rates (30 %, 50 %, and 80 %), and five temporal window sizes (24 h to 336 h). All 291 experiment result logs and scripts for reproducing the figures and tables in the manuscript. Documentation for reproducing the benchmark and extending it to additional methods, missing patterns, and evaluation metrics.
